visual_action: The video opens with a nostalgic-looking, sun-drenched photo of two silhouetted women on a beach, making heart shapes with their hands. It then transitions to a slideshow of four screenshots of tweets from Republican politicians (Marco Rubio, Lindsey Graham, John Thune, and J.D. Vance) from 2016 and an unspecified year, all expressing opposition to Donald Trump.

cast.name: Republican Party
cast.evidence: The opening text reads "pov it's 2016 and you're a republican". The video then shows tweets from multiple prominent Republican figures.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the subject of all four tweets shown in the video, e.g., Marco Rubio's tweet calls him a "con artist" and Lindsey Graham's tweet says he is "not a conservative Republican."

cast.name: Marco Rubio
cast.evidence: A screenshot of his tweet from February 26, 2016, is shown, stating, "Donald Trump is a con artist — and he cannot be our nominee. #NeverTrump".

cast.name: Lindsey Graham
cast.evidence: A screenshot of his tweet is shown, stating, "Donald Trump is not a conservative Republican. He's an opportunist. He's not fit to be President of the United States."

cast.name: John Thune
cast.evidence: A screenshot of his tweet from October 8, 2016, is shown, stating, "Donald Trump should withdraw and Mike Pence should be our nominee effective immediately."

cast.name: Mike Pence
cast.evidence: He is mentioned in John Thune's tweet as the preferred nominee over Donald Trump in 2016.

cast.name: J.D. Vance
cast.evidence: A screenshot of his tweet from March 31 is shown, stating, "In 4 years, I hope people remember that it was those of us who empathized with Trump's voters who fought him most aggressively".

audio_music: An upbeat, nostalgic-sounding pop song, identified as 'Lush Life' by Zara Larsson, plays continuously throughout the video. Its cheerful and carefree tone creates an ironic contrast with the political content.
editing_pacing: The video is a simple slideshow, starting with a still image and then cycling through four static screenshots of tweets.
cultural_references: The song 'Lush Life' by Zara Larsson, a popular song from the mid-2010s.
The visual aesthetic of 2010s social media, represented by the filtered sunset beach photo.
central_claim: Prominent Republican politicians who currently support Donald Trump, such as Marco Rubio, Lindsey Graham, and J.D. Vance, were strongly against his candidacy in 2016, suggesting their positions have changed opportunistically.
intended_effect: To portray key Republican figures as hypocritical and inconsistent by contrasting their past anti-Trump statements with their current support for him.
